Public engine tree named by the same ledger. Dedicated capture pool and in-place KV, convolution and recurrent buffers. This is the fix disposition, not the 0.70 measurement.

limitations: One H20-3e card, one workload; no concurrency

Does not establish behaviour for multi-request or paged-state graphs
